headline: Lupin Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition — Lupin Limited has informed the Exchange about Lupin Inc. U.S.A., wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has entered into a licensing agreement in exchange of 332,000 Common Shares of Kaveri Therapeutics, Inc.
